subject: Echolyn dedicated sizing: inventory check + standby proposal
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Sep 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Echolyn: late-stage sizing ask and soft-hold request

Hi team,

Echolyn (Marla Chen) is in final legal review for a Dedicated capacity deal. They’ve given a launch window tied to a customer pilot that starts 2028-11-15. High level ask from sales: reserve a mix of 8x A100-80GB (fp16/quantized) and 4x A40-class GPUs for pre-prod + staging for 6 months, with the option to convert to a steady-state reserved pool.

Can ops confirm current inventory across us-west-2 and estimate whether we can place a 45-day soft-hold that locks those nodes for conversion if they sign? Also need a quick cost delta for keeping them as standby vs immediate reserved commit. I’ve attached the Echolyn demand profile and the current SOW draft.

Quick answers appreciated — legal will push to sign once procurement clears the SLA addendum.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: echolyn_demand_profile.xlsx, SOW_draft_v3.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Sep 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Echolyn: late-stage sizing ask and soft-hold request

Priyom —

Inventory snapshot (us-west-2) as of this morning:
- Available A100-80GB nodes (cold pool): 12
- Available A40-class nodes: 9
- Immediately convertible pooled instances (warm): 6 A100-equivalent

We can support the requested 8 A100 + 4 A40 mix, but a straight 45-day soft-hold is tricky because of other mid-funnel opportunities in the same region. Options:

1) Soft-hold (45d) with nominal standby fee: we can mark 12 nodes as "standby"; fee = 10% of monthly reserved price for the duration. During the hold, nodes are excluded from new allocations. Requires Ops approval and a $25k refundable good-faith deposit.

2) Conditional pre-commit: 3-month reserved upfront (discounted) that converts remaining capacity to a reserved state on signing; no deposit but higher upfront commitment.

3) Staggered hold: lock 6 nodes now (immediately) and queue remaining 6 for rapid conversion; provides more flexibility and spreads fiscal risk.

Risk note: we have a high-priority enterprise RFP closing 10/10 that may request up to 10 A100s for short-term burst. If we take option 1, Ops will need signoff from Site Reliability lead to deprioritize that RFP for this window.

I’ll run exact costing for standby vs reserved and send numbers by EOD.

- Karthik
Head of Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Marla Chen <marla.chen@echolyn.io>, procurement@echolyn.io
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Sep 2028 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Echolyn: late-stage sizing ask and soft-hold request

Marla / Echolyn procurement —

Looping you in with Karthik (Capacity) and Lauren (AM) to align on availability and the standby options we discussed on the call. Karthik’s preliminary inventory indicates we can cover the requested mix, but we recommend one of the three standby/commit structures outlined below to avoid losing availability.

Summary of options (from Ops):
- 45d soft-hold + $25k refundable deposit + 10% standby fee (monthly)
- Conditional 3-month pre-commit (discounted) that converts remainder to reserved capacity on signature
- Staggered lock: 6 nodes now + 6 on rapid conversion queue

Can you confirm which structure procurement would prefer? Also: procurement asked whether standby can be structured as a credit against the first invoice if they convert to Reserved within 90 days — that’s something we can likely accommodate but need a written clause in the SOW.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — legal is queued to finalize SLA language once procurement provides preference.

Best,
Priyom

Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Echolyn: late-stage sizing ask and soft-hold request

Thanks, Priyom and team.

We want to avoid an upfront 3-month commit if possible — procurement prefers a soft-hold that preserves runway for internal approvals. Their asks:

- 45-day soft-hold is acceptable if the standby fee can be credited to the first invoice when we convert to Reserved within 90 days.
- Please confirm refundable deposit mechanism and timeline for return if we do not convert.
- Can you provide a simple clause to include in the SOW that binds Redwood to the hold window and node mix? Procurement needs explicit dates.

We’re close to signatures; legal will sign once the SOW includes the hold clause and credit language. Please put the clause draft in Drive and send a quick DocuSign link for the SOW v3 when ready.

—Marla
VP Infrastructure, Echolyn Labs

Attachments referenced: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marla Chen <marla.chen@echolyn.io>
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Echolyn: late-stage sizing ask and soft-hold request

Marla / Priyom —

Confirmed: ops can provision a 45-day hold for the specified mix (8x A100-80GB + 4x A40) in us-west-2. Key points for the clause we’ll put in the SOW:

- Hold window: 2028-10-02 to 2028-11-15 (45 days).
- Standby fee: 10% of monthly reserved rate, billed monthly during hold.
- Credit: standby fees paid will be applied as a one-time credit against the first reserved invoice if conversion occurs within 90 days of the hold window end.
- Refund: $25k good-faith deposit refunded in full within 30 days if no conversion; refundable only after final reconciliation of usage.
- Conversion action: Echolyn must provide written notice to convert at least 72 hours prior to desired conversion date; Redwood will convert and allocate reserved nodes within 5 business days of notice subject to control-plane checks.

I’ll upload a short clause draft to the shared Drive link and cc Legal for formal SOW language. If procurement confirms the clause wording, we’ll stamp the hold at 08:00 PT 2028-10-02.

- Karthik
Head of Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference

> Attachment: standby_fee_calc.csv (summary posted to Drive)
